command.read.meta_data.description: Read the current tab's title, URL, and meta description

command.read.body.description: Read the current tab's visible body content

options.text: Visible text only. Prefer this by default - smaller and usually sufficient for answering questions about page content.
options.full: Raw HTML including all markup and attributes. Much larger than text - only request this when you specifically need HTML structure or attributes, and check the size hint first to make sure it is not too large.
